plan.question: Does complete mandatory fallback enumeration create material pre-cancelled latency in the live AlphaBeta caller, and is existing first-legal streaming a plausible lower-cost option?
plan.roots: uniform repr-sorted legal trajectory Random(seed), sample actual prefixes0,8,16,24; terminal prefixes retained, no refill
plan.caps: 120seconds total; no search expansion because token pre-cancelled; every root retains full history
plan.decision: Consider a separately reviewed fallback optimization only if existing public Core cancellation median exceeds5ms on at least half of usable rules and Core first-legal median is below half that public cost on those rules. Native results independently reported. A changed deterministic fallback choice is a compatibility cost, not free equivalence.
plan.limits: Cost feasibility only, no product change, utility/strength/incomplete-domain claim. Full-frontier bulk and first-legal are different functions; first-legal alone does not implement the public terminal/declaration contract.
